The v1 PDB has since been reused by subsequent builds; frozen executable offsets
below remain independently reproducible without a matching PDB.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import struct
import subprocess

BASELINE = ROOT / "baseline/profiling-tests.exe"
CANDIDATE = ROOT / "short-depthwise-tests.exe"


def sha256(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def pe(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    start = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
    count = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, start + 6)[0]
    optional_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, start + 20)[0]
    sections = []
    for index in range(count):
        at = start + 24 + optional_size + index * 40
        name = data[at:at + 8].rstrip(b"\0").decode()
        virtual_size, virtual_at, raw_size, raw_at = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", data, at + 8)
        sections.append((name, virtual_at, virtual_size, raw_at, raw_size))

    def offset(rva):
        for _, virtual_at, virtual_size, raw_at, raw_size in sections:
            if virtual_at <= rva < virtual_at + max(virtual_size, raw_size):
                return raw_at + rva - virtual_at
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped RVA {rva:#x}")

    pdata = next(section for section in sections if section[0] == ".pdata")
    functions = [struct.unpack_from("<III", data, at)
                 for at in range(pdata[3], pdata[3] + pdata[4] - 11, 12)]
    return data, offset, functions

    data, offset, functions = pe(path)
    assert any(begin == start and finish == end for begin, finish, _ in functions)
    return data[offset(start):offset(end)]

    start += 0x140000000
    end += 0x140000000
    command = ["llvm-objdump", "-d", "--no-show-raw-insn",
               f"--start-address={start}", f"--stop-address={end}", str(path)]
    output = subprocess.check_output(command, text=True)
    instructions = []
    for line in output.splitlines():
        match = re.match(r"\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(.*)", line)
        if not match:
            continue
        instruction = match[2].split("#")[0].strip()
        instruction = re.sub(r" <[^>]*>", "", instruction)
        instruction = re.sub(r"[-]?0x[0-9a-f]+\(%rip\)", "RIP", instruction)

        def target(match):
            address = int(match[1], 16)
            return "FUNC+" + hex(address - start) if start <= address < end else "EXTERNAL"

        instruction = re.sub(r"(?<![$\w])0x([0-9a-f]{9,})", target, instruction)
        instructions.append(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", instruction))
    return command, instructions

        "normalization": "Remove disassembler comments/symbol annotations; replace RIP displacement with RIP; internal branch targets become function-relative offsets; external absolute call/jump targets become EXTERNAL",
        "baseline_normalized_sha256": sha256("\n".join(before).encode()),

        "normalized_instruction_stream_identical": before == after,
        "normalized_diff": list(difflib.unified_diff(before, after)),
        "commands": [baseline_command, candidate_command],
    },
    "limitations": [
        "This comparison covers profiling test executables; ordinary page executables require separate inspection.",

        "Code placement differs. Identical instruction selection does not exclude instruction-cache effects, input/weight/output allocation placement, host frequency/temperature, shared cache contention or measurement noise.",

}
destination = ROOT / "pointwise-codegen-comparison.json"
destination.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"artifact": str(destination), "tile_bytes_identical": baseline_tile == candidate_tile,
                  "caller_normalized_identical": before == after}))
